reference.title: Multipart uploads metrics
reference.shortdesc: Use these multipart upload metrics to monitor blob uploads to object storage and to help identify failures when Red Hat Quay cannot complete an upload.

section.p: The multipart uploads metrics show the number of blob uploads to storage (S3, Rados, GoogleCloudStorage, RHOCS).

entry.p: Number of multipart uploads to Red Hat Quay storage that started
Number of multipart uploads to Red Hat Quay storage that completed
